# Test fixtures

Fixtures for Krita documents, brush presets, resource bundles, and reference
strokes are stored here as compatibility parsers land.

The `.kpp` presets under `presets/` and `override/` are deterministic test files
generated by `generate_presets.py`. Re-run that script after changing the
fixture content. They contain no user artwork.

Fixtures must be redistributable under the project license or a compatible
license. User artwork must never be committed.
